# VB検索SQL・画面定義：原文根拠

入口：[業務別一覧](VB機能・条件分岐一覧.md)。元SQLはOracle構文を含みます。移行先DBの実際のビュー・関数の定義を確認したものではありません。

SQL XMLのCONDITION要素は共通組立処理へ渡す定義です。NULL引数時の省略・BETWEENの組立等は共通処理と併せて確認してください。XSDのSQLは抽出したコマンドそのもので、同名や似たCRUDが複数あります。

```sql
SELECT          TKC.TK_KIKIKOSEI_ID, TKC.TK_KIKAN_ID, TKC.KIKIKOSEI_ID,

                      TKZ.SERVICEKEITAI, SUM(TKF.HYOJUN_KIN) AS HYOJUN_KIN, 
                      NVL(TKD.SURYO_NM, 0) * NVL(SUM(TKF.HYOJUN_KIN), 0) 
                      AS HYOJUNKEI_KIN, SUM(TKF.SIKIRI_KIN) AS SIKIRI_KIN, 
                      NVL(TKD.SURYO_NM, 0) * NVL(SUM(TKF.SIKIRI_KIN), 0) AS SIKIRIKEI_KIN, 
                      TKD.TK_KIKIMEISAI_ID, TKB.SUPPORT_ID AS TKB_SUPPORT_ID_OLD, 
                      MAB.SUPPORT_ID AS MAB_SUPPORT_ID, MAE.HYOJIJUN AS MAE_HYOJIJUN, 
                      MAF.HYOJIJUN AS MAF_HYOJIJUN, TKD.KIKIMEISAI_ID
FROM            MCM_TK_KIKIKOSEI TKC, MCM_TK_KIKIMEISAI TKD, MCM_TK_TANKA TKF, 
                      MCM_TK_KIKAN TKB, MCM_TK_TANKA TKZ, MCM_MA_KIKIKOSEI MAE, 
                      MCM_MA_PLANT MAB, MCM_MA_KIKIMEISAI MAF

                      TKF.TK_KIKIMEISAI_ID = TKZ.TK_KIKIMEISAI_ID AND 
                      TKB.KAISI_DT = TKZ.KAISI_DT AND 
                      TKC.KIKIKOSEI_ID = MAE.KIKIKOSEI_ID (+) AND 
                      MAE.PLANT_ID = MAB.PLANT_ID AND 
                      TKD.KIKIMEISAI_ID = MAF.KIKIMEISAI_ID (+) AND 
                      (TKC.TK_KIKAN_ID = :TK_KIKAN_ID)
GROUP BY     TKC.TK_KIKIKOSEI_ID, TKC.TK_KIKAN_ID, TKC.KIKIKOSEI_ID, 
                      TKC.KIKIKOSEI_NK, TKC.SET_NM, TKC.TEHAISEIBAN, TKD.SEIZOMAKER_NK, 
                      TKD.KIKIHINMEI_NK, TKD.KIKIKATASHIKI, TKD.SURYO_NM,

                      TKZ.SERVICEKEITAI, TKD.TK_KIKIMEISAI_ID, TKB.SUPPORT_ID, 
                      MAB.SUPPORT_ID, MAE.HYOJIJUN, MAF.HYOJIJUN, TKD.KIKIMEISAI_ID, 
                      TKC.HYOJIJUN, TKD.HYOJIJUN
ORDER BY     TKC.HYOJIJUN, TKD.HYOJIJUN, MAE_HYOJIJUN, MAF_HYOJIJUN
```

```sql
                      TKD.KIKIKATASHIKI, TKD.SURYO_NM, TKD.ATSUKAIKIKI_ID, TKD.BIKO,

FROM            MCM_TK_KIKIMEISAI TKD, MCM_TK_KIKIKOSEI TKC,

                      TKD.KIKIMEISAI_ID = MAF.KIKIMEISAI_ID (+) AND
```

```sql
                      MAE.HYOJIJUN AS MAE_HYOJIJUN, MAF.HYOJIJUN, TKC.KIKIKOSEI_ID,

                      * NVL(TKD.SURYO_NM, 0) AS HYOJUNKEI_KIN, NVL(TKF.SIKIRI_KIN, 0) 
                      * NVL(TKD.SURYO_NM, 0) AS SIKIRIKEI_KIN

                      TMF.TM_KIKIMEISAI_ID = TMD.TM_KIKIMEISAI_ID AND 
                      TKD.KIKIMEISAI_ID = MAF.KIKIMEISAI_ID (+) AND 
                      TKC.KIKIKOSEI_ID = MAE.KIKIKOSEI_ID (+) AND
```

<a id="Q1006-013"></a>

### Q1006-013　Mcm1006u2\_MCM\_MA\_KIKIKOSEITableAdapter\_Ins

原本：[Mcm1006u2\_MCM\_MA\_KIKIKOSEITableAdapter\_Ins.xml](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/20_CONSUMER/MCM1006U/Mcm1006u2_MCM_MA_KIKIKOSEITableAdapter_Ins.xml>)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    DISTINCT
    DECODE(NVL(LEAST(MAE.KIKIKOSEI_ID,TMZ.KIKIKOSEI_ID),0), 0, 0, 1) AS CHECK_FLG
    ,MAE.KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,MAE.KIKIKOSEI_NK
    ,MAE.SET_NM
    ,MAE.TANI
    ,MAE.TEHAISEIBAN
    ,MAE.BIKO
    ,0 AS TM_IRAI_NO
    ,TMZ.TM_KIKIKOSEI_ID AS TM_KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,0 AS TK_KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,0 AS MITSUMORICHECK_FLG
    ,0 AS CHECK_FLG_OLD
    ,MAE.HYOJIJUN
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_MA_KIKIKOSEI MAE
    ,(SELECT TMC.KIKIKOSEI_ID
            ,MIN(TMC.TM_KIKIKOSEI_ID) AS TM_KIKIKOSEI_ID
        FROM MCM_TM_MITSUMORI    TMA
            ,MCM_TM_KEIYAKUJIKAN TMB
            ,MCM_TM_KIKIKOSEI    TMC
       WHERE TMA.TM_IRAI_ID          = TMB.TM_IRAI_ID
         AND TMA.TM_IRAI_ID          = TMC.TM_IRAI_ID
         AND TMB.TM_KEIYAKUJIKAN_ID IN (:{0})
    GROUP BY TMC.KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ) TMZ
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      MAE.KIKIKOSEI_ID = TMZ.KIKIKOSEI_ID(+)
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      MAE.PLANT_ID = (:{1})
    </CONDITION>
    </WHERE>
    <ORDERBY>
      MAE.HYOJIJUN
    </ORDERBY>
  </SQL>
```

```xml
    ,TMF.PACK_FLG
    ,TMF.KEIYAKUNAIYO
    ,TMF.KEIYAKU_NO

    ,MCM_TM_KIKAN TMG
    ,MCM_TM_KIKIMEISAI TMD
    ,MCM_TM_KIKIKOSEI TMC
    WHERE TMF.TM_KIKAN_ID      = TMG.TM_KIKAN_ID
```

<a id="Q1009-001"></a>

### Q1009-001　Mcm1009u\_MCM\_1003\_VTableAdapter

原本：[Mcm1009u\_MCM\_1003\_VTableAdapter.xml](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/20_CONSUMER/MCM1009U/Mcm1009u_MCM_1003_VTableAdapter.xml>)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    DISTINCT TVA.TM_IRAI_ID,
    TVA.TM_KEIYAKUJIKAN_ID,
    TVA.JOTAI,
    TVA.TM_IRAI_NO,
    TVA.MITSUMORI_DT,
    TVA.IRAITANTOSYA,
    TVA.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI,
    CASE WHEN TVA.FUSEI IS NOT NULL THEN TVA.KEIYAKU_NO || ' ' || TVA.FUSEI ELSE TVA.KEIYAKU_NO END KEIYAKU_NO,
    TVA.PACK_FLG,
    TVA.FUSEI,
    TVA.TORIHIKISAKI_ID,
    TVA.TORIHIKISAKI_CD,
    TVA.TORIHIKISAKI_NK,
    TVA.NONYUSAKI_ID,
    TVA.NONYUSAKI_CD,
    TVA.NONYUSAKI_NK,
    TVA.KYUNONYUSAKI_NK,
    TVA.NONYUSAKIKOJO_NK,
    TVA.PLANT_ID,
    TVA.SUPPORT_ID,
    TVA.PLANT_NK,
    TVA.HOSYUHOHO,
    TVA.TENKENUMU,
    TVA.TENKENKANOYOBI,
    TVA.YAKANTAIOUMU,
    TVA.KEIYAKU_DT,
    TVA.KAIYAKU_DT,
    TVA.MITSUMORI_IRAI,
    TVA.MITSUMORI_COPY,
    TVA.MITSUMORI_DEL,
    TVA.KEIYAKU_KEIYAKU,
    TVA.KEIYAKU_DEL,
    TVA.TK_KEIYAKU_ID,
    TVA.SHONINJOTAI,
    TVA.KAITOKIZITSU_DT
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_1003_V TVA,
    MCM_TM_MITSUMORI TMA
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      TVA.TM_IRAI_ID = TMA.TM_IRAI_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      TVA.TORIHIKISAKI_CD LIKE :{0}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      UPPER(TVA.TORIHIKISAKI_NK) LIKE UPPER(:{1})
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      TVA.NONYUSAKI_CD LIKE :{2}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      UPPER(TVA.NONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || TVA.KYUNONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || TVA.NONYUSAKIKANA_KN || ' ' || TVA.NONYUSAKIEIMEI_EN) LIKE UPPER(:{3})
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      TVA.SUPPORT_ID LIKE :{4}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      UPPER(TVA.PLANT_NK) LIKE UPPER(:{5})
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(:{6}, TVA.JOTAI) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(:{7}, TVA.SHONINJOTAI) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TMA.PACK_FLG = 1
    </CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
  <ORDERBY>
    TVA.TM_IRAI_NO DESC,
    TO_NUMBER(TVA.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI) ASC
  </ORDERBY>
</SQL>
```

```xml
    TVA.JOTAI,
    TVA.TM_IRAI_NO,
    TVA.MITSUMORI_DT,
    TVA.IRAITANTOSYA,
    TVA.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI,
    CASE WHEN TVA.FUSEI IS NOT NULL THEN TVA.KEIYAKU_NO || ' ' || TVA.FUSEI ELSE TVA.KEIYAKU_NO END KEIYAKU_NO,
    TVA.PACK_FLG,
    TVA.FUSEI,
    TVA.TORIHIKISAKI_ID,
    TVA.TORIHIKISAKI_CD,
    TVA.TORIHIKISAKI_NK,
    TVA.NONYUSAKI_ID,
    TVA.NONYUSAKI_CD,
    TVA.NONYUSAKI_NK,
    TVA.KYUNONYUSAKI_NK,
    TVA.NONYUSAKIKOJO_NK,
    TVA.PLANT_ID,
    TVA.SUPPORT_ID,
    TVA.PLANT_NK,
    TVA.HOSYUHOHO,
    TVA.TENKENUMU,
    TVA.TENKENKANOYOBI,
    TVA.YAKANTAIOUMU,
    TVA.KEIYAKU_DT,
    TVA.KAIYAKU_DT,
    TVA.MITSUMORI_IRAI,
    TVA.MITSUMORI_COPY,
    TVA.MITSUMORI_DEL,
    TVA.KEIYAKU_KEIYAKU,
    TVA.KEIYAKU_DEL,
    TVA.TK_KEIYAKU_ID,
    TVA.SHONINJOTAI,
    TVA.KAITOKIZITSU_DT,
    MAR.JIGYOSHO_CD,
    MAR.MEISHO4_NK
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_1003_V TVA,
    MCM_TM_MITSUMORI TMA,
    MCM_MA_DTSPLANT MAP,
    MCM_MA_TENPO MAR
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      TVA.TM_IRAI_ID = TMA.TM_IRAI_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TVA.SUPPORT_ID = REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(MAP.PLA_CODE), 'P', ''), '-', '')
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      MAP.STA_CODE = MAR.JIGYOSHO_CD
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      TVA.TORIHIKISAKI_CD LIKE :{0}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      UPPER(TVA.TORIHIKISAKI_NK) LIKE UPPER(:{1})
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      TVA.NONYUSAKI_CD LIKE :{2}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      UPPER(TVA.NONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || TVA.KYUNONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || TVA.NONYUSAKIKANA_KN || ' ' || TVA.NONYUSAKIEIMEI_EN) LIKE UPPER(:{3})
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      TVA.SUPPORT_ID LIKE :{4}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      UPPER(TVA.PLANT_NK) LIKE UPPER(:{5})
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(:{6}, TVA.JOTAI) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(:{7}, TVA.SHONINJOTAI) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TMA.TENPO_FLG = 1
    </CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
  <ORDERBY>
    TVA.TM_IRAI_NO DESC,
    TO_NUMBER(TVA.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI) ASC
  </ORDERBY>
</SQL>
```

<a id="Q1011-001"></a>

### Q1011-001　Mcm1011u\_MCM\_TK\_KEIYAKUTableAdapter

原本：[Mcm1011u\_MCM\_TK\_KEIYAKUTableAdapter.xml](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/20_CONSUMER/MCM1011U/Mcm1011u_MCM_TK_KEIYAKUTableAdapter.xml>)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    0 AS CHECK_FLG
    ,TKB.TK_KIKAN_ID AS RELATION_ID
    ,TKG.SHONINJOTAI AS SYOUNIN_JOTAI
    ,TKA.SHINSA_DT
    ,TKA.SHINSA_BY
    ,TKA.SHONIN_DT AS SYOUNIN_DT
    ,TKA.SHONIN_BY AS SYOUNIN_BY
    ,NVL(TKA.KEIYAKU_NO, '------') AS SHORUI_NO
    ,TKB.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI
    ,TKB.NONYUSAKI_NK
    ,MAA.NONYUSAKI_CD
    ,MAA.NONYUSAKI_NK
    ,MAA.KYUNONYUSAKI_NK
    ,MAA.NONYUSAKIKOJO_NK
    ,MAA.NONYUSAKIKANA_KN
    ,MAA.NONYUSAKIEIMEI_EN
    ,TKB.SUPPORT_ID
    ,TKB.PLANT_NK
    ,TKB.PLANT_ID
    ,TKA.IRAITANTOSYA AS IRAITANTO_NK
    ,TKB.SIKIRIGOKEI_KIN AS KINGAKU
    ,TKA.TK_KEIYAKU_ID
    ,TKB.KAISI_DT
    ,TKB.TORIHIKISAKI_NK
    ,TKB.NONYUSAKI_NK
    ,TKG.SHONIN_NO
    ,TKA.JOTAI
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_TK_KEIYAKU TKA,
    MCM_TK_KIKAN TKB
    ,(SELECT MIN(KAISI_DT)
    ,TK_KEIYAKU_ID
    FROM MCM_TK_KIKAN
    GROUP BY TK_KEIYAKU_ID) TKV
    ,(SELECT TK_KIKAN_ID
    ,CASE SHONINJOTAI
    WHEN '3' THEN to_char(LASTUPDATE_DT,'yyyymmddhhmiss')
    ELSE :${6} END AS SHONIN_NO
    ,MAX(SHONINJOTAI) AS SHONINJOTAI
    FROM MCM_TK_TENPU
    GROUP BY TK_KIKAN_ID
    ,CASE SHONINJOTAI
    WHEN '3' THEN to_char(LASTUPDATE_DT,'yyyymmddhhmiss')
    ELSE :${6} END ) TKG
    ,MCM_MA_NONYUSAKI MAA
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      TKA.TK_KEIYAKU_ID = TKB.TK_KEIYAKU_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TKA.TK_KEIYAKU_ID = TKV.TK_KEIYAKU_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TKG.TK_KIKAN_ID   = TKB.TK_KIKAN_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TKB.NONYUSAKI_CD LIKE :{1} || '%'
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(MAA.NONYUSAKI_NK, :{2}) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(TKB.SUPPORT_ID, :{3}) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(TKB.PLANT_NK, :{4}) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(:{5}, TKG.SHONINJOTAI) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TKG.SHONINJOTAI &lt;> '0'
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TKB.NONYUSAKI_ID = MAA.NONYUSAKI_ID
    </CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
  <ORDERBY>
    TKA.LASTUPDATE_DT ASC
  </ORDERBY>
</SQL>
```

<a id="Q1011-002"></a>

### Q1011-002　Mcm1011u\_MCM\_TK\_TENPUTableAdapter

原本：[Mcm1011u\_MCM\_TK\_TENPUTableAdapter.xml](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/20_CONSUMER/MCM1011U/Mcm1011u_MCM_TK_TENPUTableAdapter.xml>)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    TK_TENPU_ID AS TENPU_ID
    ,TENPUFILE_NK
    ,"DIRECTORY"
    ,TKB.TK_KIKAN_ID AS RELATION_ID
    ,CASE TKG.SHONINJOTAI
    WHEN '3' THEN to_char(TKG.LASTUPDATE_DT,'yyyymmddhhmiss')
    ELSE :${6} END AS SHONIN_NO
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_TK_KEIYAKU TKA,
    MCM_TK_KIKAN TKB,
    MCM_TK_TENPU TKG
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      TKA.TK_KEIYAKU_ID = TKB.TK_KEIYAKU_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TKB.TK_KIKAN_ID = TKG.TK_KIKAN_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TKB.NONYUSAKI_CD LIKE :{1} || '%'
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(TKB.NONYUSAKI_NK, :{2}) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(TKB.SUPPORT_ID, :{3}) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(TKB.PLANT_NK, :{4}) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(:{5}, TKG.SHONINJOTAI) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TKG.SHONINJOTAI &lt;> '0'
    </CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
  <ORDERBY>
    TKA.TK_KEIYAKU_ID
  </ORDERBY>
</SQL>
```

<a id="Q2007-001"></a>

### Q2007-001　Mcm2007u2\_MCM\_MA\_BRAND\_KOSEITableAdapter

原本：[Mcm2007u2\_MCM\_MA\_BRAND\_KOSEITableAdapter.xml](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/30_CUSTOMER/MCM2007U/Mcm2007u2_MCM_MA_BRAND_KOSEITableAdapter.xml>)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    MAD.BRANDKOSEI_ID
    ,MAD.BRANDSYOSAI_NK
    ,MAD.BRAND_ID
    ,UMV.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID
    ,UMV.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI
    ,UMV.SOFTHOSYUHOHO
    ,UMV.SOFT_FLG
    ,UMV.DREMOS_FLG
    ,UMV.REMOTE_FLG
    ,'' AS UM_MITSUMORI_NO
    ,MAD.HYOJIJUN
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_MA_BRAND_KOSEI MAD
    ,(
    SELECT UMB.BRANDKOSEI_ID
    ,UMB.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID
    ,UMB.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI
    ,UMB.SOFTHOSYUHOHO
    ,UMB.SOFT_FLG
    ,UMB.DREMOS_FLG
    ,UMB.REMOTE_FLG
    FROM MCM_UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI UMA
    ,MCM_UM_KIHON_BRAND     UMB
    ,MCM_UM_MITSUMORI       UMG
    WHERE UMA.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID = UMB.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID
    AND UMA.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID = UMG.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID
    AND UMG.UM_MITSUMORI_ID IN (:{0})
    ) UMV
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      MAD.BRANDKOSEI_ID = UMV.BRANDKOSEI_ID(+)
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      MAD.PLANT_ID = (:{1})
    </CONDITION>
    </WHERE>
    <ORDERBY>
      MAD.HYOJIJUN
    </ORDERBY>
  </SQL>
```

<a id="Q2007-002"></a>

### Q2007-002　Mcm2007u2\_MCM\_MA\_KIKIKOSEITableAdapter

原本：[Mcm2007u2\_MCM\_MA\_KIKIKOSEITableAdapter.xml](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/30_CUSTOMER/MCM2007U/Mcm2007u2_MCM_MA_KIKIKOSEITableAdapter.xml>)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    DECODE(NVL(LEAST(MAE.KIKIKOSEI_ID,UMV.KIKIKOSEI_ID),0), 0, 0, 1) AS CHECK_FLG
    ,MAE.KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,MAE.KIKIKOSEI_NK
    ,NVL(UMV.SET_NM,MAE.SET_NM) AS SET_NM
    ,MAE.TANI
    ,MAE.TEHAISEIBAN
    ,MAE.BIKO
    ,MAE.CONTROLLER_FLG
    ,UMV.HOSYUHOHO
    ,UMV.BRANDKOSEI_ID
    ,UMV.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID
    ,UMV.UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID AS UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,0 AS UK_KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,0 AS MITSUMORICHECK_FLG
    ,0 AS CHECK_FLG_OLD
    ,MAD.HYOJIJUN AS MAD_HYOJIJUN
    ,MAE.HYOJIJUN
    ,'' AS UM_MITSUMORI_NO
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_MA_KIKIKOSEI   MAE
    ,MCM_MA_BRAND_KOSEI MAD
    ,(
    SELECT UMB.BRANDKOSEI_ID
    ,UMB.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID
    ,UMC.KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,UMC.UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,UMC.HOSYUHOHO
    ,UMC.SET_NM
    FROM MCM_UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI UMA
    ,MCM_UM_KIHON_BRAND     UMB
    ,MCM_UM_KIKIKOSEI       UMC
    ,MCM_UM_MITSUMORI       UMG
    WHERE UMA.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID = UMB.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID
    AND UMA.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID = UMG.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID
    AND UMB.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID     = UMC.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID
    AND UMG.UM_MITSUMORI_ID IN (:{0})
    ) UMV
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      MAE.KIKIKOSEI_ID = UMV.KIKIKOSEI_ID(+)
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      MAD.BRANDKOSEI_ID = UMV.BRANDKOSEI_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      MAE.PLANT_ID = (:{1})
    </CONDITION>
    </WHERE>
    <ORDERBY>
      MAD.HYOJIJUN
      ,MAE.HYOJIJUN
    </ORDERBY>
  </SQL>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    DISTINCT
    DECODE(NVL(LEAST(MAV.MAF_KIKIMEISAI_ID,UMV.KIKIMEISAI_ID),0), 0, 0, 1) AS CHECK_FLG
    ,MAV.MAF_KIKIKOSEI_ID AS KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,MAV.MAF_KIKIMEISAI_ID AS KIKIMEISAI_ID
    ,MAV.MAF_KIKIHINMEI_NK AS KIKIHINMEI_NK
    ,MAV.MAF_KIKIKATASHIKI AS KIKIKATASHIKI
    ,MAV.MAF_SURYO_NM AS SURYO_NM
    ,MAV.MAF_ATSUKAIKIKI_ID AS ATSUKAIKIKI_ID
    ,MAV.MAF_BIKO AS BIKO
    ,MAV.MAJ_SEIZOMAKER_ID AS SEIZOMAKER_ID
    ,MAV.MAJ_SEIZOMAKER_NK AS SEIZOMAKER_NK
    ,UMV.KEIYAKUNAIYO
    ,UMV.KEIYAKU_NO
    ,UMV.SERVICEKEITAI
    ,UMV.TORIHOSYUJIKAN_ID
    ,UMV.DAIFUKUHOSYUJIKAN_ID
    ,UMV.TENKENKAISU
    ,UMV.TENKENYOBI
    ,UMV.HOSYUHOHO
    ,MAV.MAG_BRANDKOSEI_ID AS BRANDKOSEI_ID
    ,UMV.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID
    ,UMV.UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID AS UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,UMV.UM_KIKIMEISAI_ID AS UM_KIKIMEISAI_ID
    ,0 AS UK_KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,0 AS UK_KIKIMEISAI_ID
    ,0 AS MITSUMORICHECK_FLG
    ,0 AS CHECK_FLG_OLD
    ,MAV.MAD_HYOJIJUN AS MAD_HYOJIJUN
    ,MAV.MAE_HYOJIJUN AS MAE_HYOJIJUN
    ,MAV.MAF_HYOJIJUN AS MAF_HYOJIJUN
    ,'' AS UM_MITSUMORI_NO
    ,MAV.MAM_KOTAIKANRI_FLG AS KOTAIKANRI_FLG
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_MA_KOTAIMEISAI_V MAV
    ,(
    SELECT UMB.BRANDKOSEI_ID
    ,UMB.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID
    ,UMC.KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,UMC.UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID
    ,UMD.KIKIMEISAI_ID
    ,UMD.UM_KIKIMEISAI_ID
    ,UMD.SURYO_NM
    ,UMF.PACK_FLG
    ,UMF.KEIYAKUNAIYO
    ,UMF.KEIYAKU_NO
    ,UMF.SERVICEKEITAI
    ,UMF.TORIHOSYUJIKAN_ID
    ,UMF.DAIFUKUHOSYUJIKAN_ID
    ,UMF.TENKENKAISU
    ,UMF.TENKENYOBI
    ,UMF.HOSYUHOHO
    FROM MCM_UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI UMA
    ,MCM_UM_KIHON_BRAND     UMB
    ,MCM_UM_KIKIKOSEI       UMC
    ,MCM_UM_MITSUMORI       UMG
    ,MCM_UM_KIKIMEISAI      UMD
    ,MCM_UM_TANKA           UMF
    WHERE UMA.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID = UMB.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID
    AND UMA.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID = UMG.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID
    AND UMB.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID     = UMC.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID
    AND UMC.UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID       = UMD.UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID
    AND UMD.UM_KIKIMEISAI_ID      = UMF.UM_KIKIMEISAI_ID
    AND UMG.UM_MITSUMORI_ID       = UMF.UM_MITSUMORI_ID
    AND UMG.UM_MITSUMORI_ID IN (:{0})
    ) UMV
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      MAV.MAF_KIKIMEISAI_ID = UMV.KIKIMEISAI_ID(+)
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      MAV.MAD_BRANDKOSEI_ID = UMV.BRANDKOSEI_ID(+)
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      MAV.MAH_DUMMY_FLG = 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      MAV.MAE_PLANT_ID  = (:{1})
    </CONDITION>
    </WHERE>
    <ORDERBY>
      MAV.MAD_HYOJIJUN
      ,MAV.MAE_HYOJIJUN
      ,MAV.MAF_HYOJIJUN
    </ORDERBY>
  </SQL>
```

```xml
    ,MAV.MAF_HYOJIJUN

  <FROM>
    MCM_MA_KOTAIMEISAI_V MAV

    ,MCM_UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI UMA
    ,MCM_MA_BRAND MAC

  <WHERE>

      MAV.MAE_KIKIKOSEI_ID  = UMV.UMC_KIKIKOSEI_ID(+)

    <CONDITION>
      UMA.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID(+) = UMV.UMB_UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      MAV.MAD_BRAND_ID = MAC.BRAND_ID

    <CONDITION>
```

```sql
SELECT          '' AS UM_MITSUMORI_NO, 0 AS CHECK_FLG, MAE.KIKIKOSEI_ID, 
                      MAE.KIKIKOSEI_NK, MAE.SET_NM, MAE.TANI, MAE.TEHAISEIBAN, MAE.BIKO, 
                      MAD.BRANDKOSEI_ID, 0 AS UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID, 0 AS UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID, 
                      0 AS UK_KIKIKOSEI_ID, 0 AS UK_KIKIKOSEI_ID, 0 AS MITSUMORICHECK_FLG, 
                      0 AS CHECK_FLG_OLD, MAD.HYOJIJUN AS MAD_HYOJIJUN, 
                      MAE.HYOJIJUN, MAE.CONTROLLER_FLG, '' AS HOSYUHOHO
FROM            MCM_MA_KIKIKOSEI MAE, MCM_MA_PLANT MAB, 
                      MCM_MA_BRAND_KOSEI MAD
WHERE           MAE.PLANT_ID = MAB.PLANT_ID AND MAB.PLANT_ID = MAD.PLANT_ID AND
```

<a id="Q3002-001"></a>

### Q3002-001　Mcm3002u\_MCM\_TK\_SIHARAI\_VTableAdapter

原本：[Mcm3002u\_MCM\_TK\_SIHARAI\_VTableAdapter.xml](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/40_ETC/MCM3002U/Mcm3002u_MCM_TK_SIHARAI_VTableAdapter.xml>)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
     TKV.TK_KIKAN_ID
    ,TKV.TORIHIKISAKI_ID
    ,TKV.NONYUSAKI_CD
    ,TKV.SUPPORT_ID
    ,TKV.JOTAI
    ,TKV.NONYUSAKI_NK
    ,TKV.TENPO_NK
    ,TKV.KEIYAKU_NO
    ,TKV.TORIHIKISAKI_CD
    ,TKV.TORIHIKISAKI_NK
    ,(SELECT MAL.TORISYUTANTOSYA_NK
        FROM MCM_MA_TORIMADOGUCHI MAL
       WHERE  MAL.TORIHIKISAKI_ID = TKV.TORIHIKISAKI_ID
         AND  MAL.MADOGUCHI_KBN   = '2'
         AND  MAL.YUKO_FLG        = '0'
         AND  ROWNUM &lt;= 1
    ) AS TORISYUTANTOSYA_NK
    ,TKV.SIHARAI
    ,TKV.KAISU
    ,TKV.BIKO
    ,TKV.TSUKI
    ,TKV.HARD_SEIBAN
    ,MCM_FN_SIHARAI(TKV.TK_KIKAN_ID, TKV.KAISI_DT, TKV.SYURYO_DT, TKV.TSUKI) AS MCM_FN_SIHARAI
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_TK_SIHARAI_V TKV
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      TRUNC(TKV.TSUKI, 'DD') = :{0}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TKV.SIHARAI = :{1}
    </CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
  <ORDERBY>
     TKV.TORIHIKISAKI_ID ASC
    ,TKV.KEIYAKU_NO ASC
    ,TKV.NONYUSAKI_CD ASC
    ,TKV.SUPPORT_ID ASC
  </ORDERBY>
</SQL>
```

```xml
    ,TKV.NONYUSAKI_ID
    ,TKV.NONYUSAKI_NK

    ,TKV.NONYUSAKIKANA_KN
    ,TKV.PLANT_ID
    ,TKV.PLANT_NK

    ,TKV.NONYUBUSYO_NK
    ,TKV.NONYUTEL_NO
    ,TKV.BRAND_NK
    ,TKV.KIKIHINMEI_NK
    ,TKV.HOSHUGAISHA_NK

    ,TKV.TORIHIKISAKI_NK
    ,TKV.KEIYAKU_NO
    ,TKV.KEIYAKU_DT
    ,TKV.KAIYAKU_DT
    ,TKV.BIKO
  </SELECT>
```

```xml
    VOA.SUPPORT_ID ASC,
```

```xml
<SQL>
```

```xml
    VOF.MAR_TENPORYAKU_NK,
    VOF.MAR_TANTO_NK,
    VOF.UKB_NONYUSAKI_CD,

    VOF.UKB_SUPPORT_ID,
    VOF.UKB_PLANT_NK,
    VOF.UKB_HOSYU_GKIN,
    VOF.UKA_KEIYAKU_NO,
    CASE VOF.UKA_KEIYAKUMANRYO_DT WHEN TO_DATE('9999/12/31', 'YYYY/MM/DD') THEN NULL ELSE VOF.UKA_KEIYAKUMANRYO_DT END UKA_KEIYAKUMANRYO_DT,
    VOF.START_DT,
    VOF.SYURYO_DT,
    VOF.HARD_SEIBAN
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_ALERT6_V VOF
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      NVL(VOF.SYURYO_DT, TO_DATE(:{0} || '/01', 'YYYY/MM/DD')) BETWEEN TO_DATE(:{0} || '/01', 'YYYY/MM/DD')
      AND ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(:{0} || '/01', 'YYYY/MM/DD'), :{1}) - 1
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      NVL(TRUNC(VOF.SYURYO_DT, 'DD'), TO_DATE(:{0} || '/01', 'YYYY/MM/DD')) &lt; TRUNC(VOF.UKA_KAIYAKU_DT, 'DD')
    </CONDITION>
  </WHERE>

    VOF.MAR_TENPORYAKU_NK ASC,
    VOF.UKB_NONYUSAKI_CD ASC,
```

```xml
    VOI.NONYUSAKI_NK,
    VOI.SUPPORT_ID,
    VOI.PLANT_NK,
    VOI.PACK_FLG,
    VOI.KEIYAKU_NO,
    VOI.PACKKEIYAKUNAIYO,
    VOI.BIKO,
    VOI.KEIYAKU_DT,
    VOI.KAIYAKU_DT,
    VOI.KEIYAKUMANRYO_DT,
    VOI.ENTYOKEIYAKUMANRYO_DT,
    VOI.HOSYUHOHO,

    VOI.SIKIRISYOKEI_KIN,
    VOI.SYUSSEINEBIKI_KIN,
    VOI.SIKIRIGOKEI_KIN
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_ALERT9_V VOI
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      VOI.TORIHIKISAKI_CD LIKE :{0}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      VOI.TORIHIKISAKI_NK LIKE :{1}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      VOI.TK_KIKAN_ID = (SELECT MAX(S.TK_KIKAN_ID) FROM MCM_TK_KIKAN S WHERE S.TK_KEIYAKU_ID = VOI.TK_KEIYAKU_ID AND S.YUKO_FLG &lt;= 0 AND :{2} BETWEEN S.KAISI_DT AND S.SYURYO_DT)
    </CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
  <GROUPBY>
    VOI.TORIHIKISAKI_CD,
    VOI.TORIHIKISAKI_NK,
    VOI.NONYUSAKI_CD,
    VOI.NONYUSAKI_NK,
    VOI.SUPPORT_ID,
    VOI.PLANT_NK,
    VOI.PACK_FLG,
    VOI.KEIYAKU_NO,
    VOI.PACKKEIYAKUNAIYO,
    VOI.BIKO,
    VOI.KEIYAKU_DT,
    VOI.KAIYAKU_DT,
    VOI.KEIYAKUMANRYO_DT,
    VOI.ENTYOKEIYAKUMANRYO_DT,
    VOI.HOSYUHOHO,
    VOI.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI,
    VOI.KAISI_DT,
    VOI.SYURYO_DT,
    VOI.HYOJUNGOKEI_KIN,
    VOI.SIKIRISYOKEI_KIN,
    VOI.SYUSSEINEBIKI_KIN,
    VOI.SIKIRIGOKEI_KIN
  </GROUPBY>
  <ORDERBY>
    VOI.NONYUSAKI_CD ASC,
    VOI.SUPPORT_ID ASC,
    VOI.TORIHIKISAKI_CD ASC,
    VOI.KEIYAKU_NO ASC,
    TO_NUMBER(VOI.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI) ASC
  </ORDERBY>
</SQL>
```

原本：[Mcm3007u\_MCM\_2004\_VTableAdapter.xml](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/40_ETC/MCM3007U/Mcm3007u_MCM_2004_VTableAdapter.xml>)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    UVA.UM_KIHON_MITSUMORI_ID,
    UVA.JOTAI,
    UVA.UM_MITSUMORI_NO,
    UVA.KEIYAKU_NO,
    UVA.UK_KEIYAKU_ID,
    UVA.FUSEI,
    UVA.NONYUSAKI_ID,
    UVA.NONYUSAKI_CD,
    UVA.NONYUSAKI_NK,
    UVA.KYUNONYUSAKI_NK,
    UVA.NONYUSAKIKOJO_NK,
    UVA.NONYUSAKIKANA_KN,
    UVA.NONYUSAKIEIMEI_EN,
    UVA.PLANT_ID,
    UVA.SUPPORT_ID,
    UVA.PLANT_NK,
    UVA.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI,
    UVA.HOSYUHOHO,
    UVA.MITSUMORILEVEL,
    UVA.MITSUMORI_DT,
    UVA.MITSUMORISAKUSEISYA_NK,
    UVA.SOFUTENPO_ID,
    UVA.SOFUMEISHO1_NK,
    UVA.SOFUMEISHO2_NK,
    UVA.SOFUMEISHO3_NK,
    UVA.SOFUMEISHO4_NK,
    UVA.SOFUTENPORYAKU_NK,
    UVA.SOFUTANTO_NK,
    UVA.KEIYAKU_DT,
    UVA.KAIYAKU_DT,
    UVA.SYOUNIN_JOTAI,
    UVA.MITSUMORI_UPD,
    UVA.MITSUMORI_COPY,
    UVA.MITSUMORI_DEL,
    UVA.KEIYAKU_KEIYAKU,
    UVA.KEIYAKU_DEL
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_2004_V UVA
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>INSTR(UVA.NONYUSAKI_CD, :{0}) > 0</CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>INSTR(UPPER(UVA.NONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || UVA.KYUNONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || UVA.NONYUSAKIKANA_KN || '' || UVA.NONYUSAKIEIMEI_EN), UPPER(:{1})) > 0</CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>INSTR(UVA.SUPPORT_ID, :{2}) > 0</CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>INSTR(UVA.PLANT_NK, :{3}) > 0</CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>INSTR(:{4}, UVA.JOTAI) > 0</CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>INSTR(:{5}, UVA.SYOUNIN_JOTAI) > 0</CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
  <ORDERBY>
    UVA.UM_MITSUMORI_NO ASC,
    UVA.KEIYAKU_NO ASC
  </ORDERBY>
</SQL>
```

<a id="Q3007-002"></a>

### Q3007-002　Mcm3007u\_MCM\_MA\_BRAND\_KOSEITableAdapter

原本：[Mcm3007u\_MCM\_MA\_BRAND\_KOSEITableAdapter.xml](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/40_ETC/MCM3007U/Mcm3007u_MCM_MA_BRAND_KOSEITableAdapter.xml>)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    COUNT(*) AS SURYO,
    MAC.BRAND_NK,
    MAD.PLANT_ID,
    MAD.BRAND_ID
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_MA_BRAND_KOSEI MAD INNER JOIN
    MCM_MA_BRAND MAC ON MAD.BRAND_ID = MAC.BRAND_ID
  </FROM>
    <WHERE>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      EXISTS (SELECT MAB.PLANT_ID FROM MCM_MA_PLANT MAB WHERE MAB.PLANT_ID = MAD.PLANT_ID AND EXISTS (SELECT MAA.NONYUSAKI_ID FROM MCM_MA_NONYUSAKI MAA WHERE MAA.NONYUSAKI_ID = MAB.NONYUSAKI_ID AND MAA.NONYUSAKI_CD LIKE :{0}))
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      EXISTS (SELECT MAB.PLANT_ID FROM MCM_MA_PLANT MAB WHERE MAB.PLANT_ID = MAD.PLANT_ID AND EXISTS (SELECT MAA.NONYUSAKI_ID FROM MCM_MA_NONYUSAKI MAA WHERE MAA.NONYUSAKI_ID = MAB.NONYUSAKI_ID AND INSTR(UPPER(MAA.NONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || MAA.KYUNONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || MAA.NONYUSAKIKOJO_NK || ' ' || MAA.NONYUSAKIKANA_KN || ' ' || MAA.NONYUSAKIEIMEI_EN), UPPER(:{1})) > 0))
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      EXISTS (SELECT MAB.PLANT_ID FROM MCM_MA_PLANT MAB WHERE MAB.PLANT_ID = MAD.PLANT_ID AND MAB.SUPPORT_ID LIKE :{2})
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      EXISTS (SELECT MAB.PLANT_ID FROM MCM_MA_PLANT MAB WHERE MAB.PLANT_ID = MAD.PLANT_ID AND UPPER(MAB.PLANT_NK) LIKE UPPER(:{3}))
    </CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
  <GROUPBY>
    MAC.BRAND_NK,
    MAD.PLANT_ID,
    MAD.BRAND_ID,
    MAC.HYOJIJUN
  </GROUPBY>
  <ORDERBY>
    MAC.HYOJIJUN ASC
  </ORDERBY>
</SQL>
```

<a id="Q3007-003"></a>

### Q3007-003　Mcm3007u\_MCM\_MA\_NONYUSAKITableAdapter

原本：[Mcm3007u\_MCM\_MA\_NONYUSAKITableAdapter.xml](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/40_ETC/MCM3007U/Mcm3007u_MCM_MA_NONYUSAKITableAdapter.xml>)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    DISTINCT 'プラント追加' AS PLANTTSUIKA,
    MAA.NONYUSAKI_ID,
    MAA.NONYUSAKI_CD,
    MAA.NONYUSAKI_NK,
    MAA.KYUNONYUSAKI_NK,
    MAA.NONYUSAKIKOJO_NK,
    MAA.NONYUSAKIKANA_KN,
    MAA.NONYUSAKIEIMEI_EN,
    MAA.YUBIN_NO,
    MAA.JUSYO1_NK,
    MAA.JUSYO2_NK,
    MAA.KUNI_NK,
    MAA.TEL_NO,
    MAA.FAX_NO,
    MAA.BIKO,
    MAA.DTSRENKEI_FLG,
    MAA.CREATED_DT,
    MAA.CREATED_BY,
    MAA.LASTUPDATE_DT,
    MAA.LASTUPDATE_BY,
    MAB.PLANT_ID,
    MAB.SUPPORT_ID,
    MAB.PLANT_NK,
    MAB.NONYU_DT,
    MAB.TEKKYO_DT,
    MAB.HOSYUSYUSOKU_DT,
    mcm_fn_kengenLink(MAB.PLANT_ID, :{5}) AS KIKIKOSEILINK
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_MA_NONYUSAKI MAA,
    MCM_2004_V UVA,
    MCM_MA_PLANT MAB
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      MAA.NONYUSAKI_ID = UVA.NONYUSAKI_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      UVA.PLANT_ID = MAB.PLANT_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      MAA.NONYUSAKI_CD LIKE :{0}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(UPPER(MAA.NONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || MAA.KYUNONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || MAA.NONYUSAKIKOJO_NK || ' ' || MAA.NONYUSAKIKANA_KN || ' ' || MAA.NONYUSAKIEIMEI_EN), UPPER(:{1})) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      MAB.SUPPORT_ID LIKE :{2}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      UPPER(MAB.PLANT_NK) LIKE UPPER(:{3})
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(:{4}, UVA.JOTAI) > 0
    </CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
  <ORDERBY>
    MAA.NONYUSAKI_ID ASC
  </ORDERBY>
</SQL>
```

```xml
    MCM_UM_KOTAIMEISAI UME,
    MCM_UM_KIKIMEISAI UMD,
    MCM_UM_KIKIKOSEI UMC,
    MCM_UM_KIHON_BRAND UMB
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      TVA.TM_IRAI_ID = TMC.TM_IRAI_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TMC.TM_KIKIKOSEI_ID = TMD.TM_KIKIKOSEI_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TMD.TM_KIKIMEISAI_ID = TME.TM_KIKIMEISAI_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      TME.KOTAIKANRI_ID = UME.KOTAIKANRI_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      UME.UM_KIKIMEISAI_ID = UMD.UM_KIKIMEISAI_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      UMD.UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID = UMC.UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      UMC.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID = UMB.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      TVA.NONYUSAKI_CD LIKE :{0}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      UPPER(TVA.NONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || TVA.KYUNONYUSAKI_NK || ' ' || TVA.NONYUSAKIKANA_KN || ' ' || TVA.NONYUSAKIEIMEI_EN) LIKE UPPER(:{1})
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION SUFFIX="%">
      TVA.SUPPORT_ID LIKE :{2}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION PREFIX="%" SUFFIX="%">
      UPPER(TVA.PLANT_NK) LIKE UPPER(:{3})
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(:{4}, TVA.JOTAI) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(:{5}, TVA.SHONINJOTAI) > 0
    </CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
  <ORDERBY>
    TVA.TM_IRAI_NO DESC,
    TO_NUMBER(TVA.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI) ASC
  </ORDERBY>
</SQL>
```

<a id="Q3008-001"></a>

### Q3008-001　Mcm3008u\_MCM\_UK\_SEIBANTableAdapter

原本：[Mcm3008u\_MCM\_UK\_SEIBANTableAdapter.xml](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/40_ETC/MCM3008U/Mcm3008u_MCM_UK_SEIBANTableAdapter.xml>)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    0 AS CHECK_FLG,
    UKI.UK_SEIBAN_ID,
    UKI.UK_KEIYAKU_ID,
    UKI.HARD_SEIBAN,
    UKI.SOFT_SEIBAN,
    UKI.KAISI_DT,
    UKI.SYURYO_DT,
    UKI.BIKO,
    UKI.CREATED_DT,
    UKI.CREATED_BY,
    UKI.LASTUPDATE_DT,
    UKI.LASTUPDATE_BY,
    UKI.KAKUNIN_DT,
    UKI.KAKUNIN_BY,
    UKI.KAKUNIN_KBN,
    UKB.NONYUSAKI_ID,
    UKB.NONYUSAKI_CD,
    UKB.NONYUSAKI_NK,
    UKB.NONYUSAKIJUSYO1_NK,
    UKB.NONYUSAKIJUSYO2_NK,
    UKB.HOSYU_GKIN,
    UKB.PLANT_ID,
    UKB.SUPPORT_ID,
    UKB.PLANT_NK,
    UKB.NONYUBUSYO_NK,
    UKB.NONYUTANTOSYA_NK,
    UKB.NONYUTEL_NO,
    UKB.NONYUFAX_NO,
    UKB.KEIYAKUJIKANTAI,
    UKB.HOSYUHOHO,
    UKB.IRAITENPO_ID,
    UKB.IRAIMEISHO1_NK,
    UKB.IRAIMEISHO2_NK,
    UKB.IRAIMEISHO3_NK,
    UKB.IRAIMEISHO4_NK,
    UKB.IRAITENPORYAKU_NK,
    UKB.IRAITANTO_NK,
    UKI.KAKUNINIRAI_DT,
    UKI.KAKUNINIRAI_BY
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
    MCM_UK_SEIBAN UKI,
    MCM_UK_KEIYAKU UKA,
    MCM_UK_KIKAN UKB
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>
      UKI.UK_KEIYAKU_ID = UKA.UK_KEIYAKU_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      UKB.UK_KEIYAKU_ID = UKA.UK_KEIYAKU_ID
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      UKI.KAKUNIN_KBN != '1'
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      UKB.YUKO_FLG = 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      UKB.UK_KIKAN_ID = (SELECT MAX(UK_KIKAN_ID) AS EXPR1 FROM MCM_UK_KIKAN WKB WHERE (UK_KEIYAKU_ID = UKA.UK_KEIYAKU_ID))
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      UKB.IRAITENPO_ID = :{0}
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(UKB.NONYUSAKI_CD, :{1}) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(UPPER(UKB.NONYUSAKI_NK), UPPER(:{2})) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(UKB.SUPPORT_ID, :{3}) > 0
    </CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>
      INSTR(UKB.PLANT_NK, :{4}) > 0
    </CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
</SQL>
```

```sql
                      UKB.NONYUSAKIJUSYO1_NK, UKB.NONYUSAKIJUSYO2_NK, UKB.HOSYU_GKIN,
```

<a id="VQ2007-006"></a>

### VQ2007-006

原本：[Mcm2007uScreen.vb:235](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/30_APPLICATION/30_CUSTOMER/MCM2007U/Mcm2007uScreen.vb>)。呼出し元：[F2007-17-002](VB条件分岐_原文根拠.md#F2007-17-002)。

```vb
        sql = " SELECT COUNT(*)" & _
              "  FROM (" & _
              "         SELECT UMD.KIKIMEISAI_ID" & _
              "               ,UME.KOTAIKANRI_ID" & _
              "               ,COUNT(*)" & _
              "           FROM MCM_UM_BRAND       UMH" & _
              "               ,MCM_UM_KIHON_BRAND UMB" & _
              "               ,MCM_UM_KIKIKOSEI   UMC" & _
              "               ,MCM_UM_KIKIMEISAI  UMD" & _
              "               ,MCM_UM_KOTAIMEISAI UME" & _
              "          WHERE UMB.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID   = UMH.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID" & _
              "            AND UMB.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID   = UMC.UM_KIHON_BRAND_ID" & _
              "            AND UMC.UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID     = UMD.UM_KIKIKOSEI_ID" & _
              "            AND UMD.UM_KIKIMEISAI_ID    = UME.UM_KIKIMEISAI_ID" & _
              "            AND UMH.UM_MITSUMORI_ID IN (" & umMitsumoriID & ")" & _
              "         GROUP BY" & _
              "                UMD.KIKIMEISAI_ID" & _
              "               ,UME.KOTAIKANRI_ID" & _
              "         HAVING COUNT(*) > 1" & _
              "      )"
```

## Designerの初期設定・表示文言・データ連携

Designerの値は初期値です。起動後のEnabled・Visible・ReadOnlyはScreenやTabControlで上書きされるため、これだけで実際の活性や権限を確定しないでください。Required・ValidateKey・Immediate等の入力設定、権限通過・変更チェック通過、列ヘッダー・バインド項目・追加削除・親子連動・更新順・チェック値も索引に残しています。
